1. Why folds 1-3 (early sequence) all failed — possible data issue at period start
2. Why fold 8 failed separately — potential regime sensitivity
3. Whether the exposure floor (0.0) indicates the model goes flat under certain conditions

Recommend human review before resuming lane.
